nodes.description: SafeMath contract grouping arithmetic helpers safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul, safeDiv
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c); computes c = a + b and requires c >= a
Parameter a of safeAdd
Parameter b of safeAdd
Local return variable c of safeAdd
require(c >= a) guard preventing addition overflow inside safeAdd
safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c); requires b <= a then c = a - b
Parameter a of safeSub
Parameter b of safeSub
Local return variable c of safeSub
require(b <= a) guard preventing subtraction underflow inside safeSub
safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c); computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b
Parameter a of safeMul
Parameter b of safeMul
Local return variable c of safeMul
require(a == 0 || c / a == b) guard preventing multiplication overflow inside safeMul
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c); requires b > 0 then c = a / b
Parameter a of safeDiv
Parameter b of safeDiv
Local return variable c of safeDiv
require(b > 0) guard preventing division by zero inside safeDiv
